title: Borani Esfenaj (Persian Spinach and Yoghurt with Golden Onion)
summary: Onion fried golden with garlic and turmeric, spinach wilted in the same pan until dry, then cooled and folded into thick yoghurt with lemon zest and juice. Chilled for 2 hours and finished with olive oil.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
plain yoghurt or water, to loosen

steps.title: Fry the onion
steps.text: Heat the oil in the pan over medium-high heat and fry the onion for 6-8 min until golden brown. Lower the heat to medium-low, add the garlic for 2 min, then stir in the turmeric for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Raise the heat to medium, add half the spinach and toss with tongs until it collapses, then add the rest with the salt and pepper. Cook for 3-5 min until wilted and the pan is dry. Tip into the bowl and leave to cool completely.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Stir in the Greek yoghurt, the loosening yoghurt, lemon zest and juice. Taste and add more lemon if you like. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours so the flavours settle.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Stir, spread in a shallow dish and drizzle with olive oil.

tips: Cook the spinach until the pan is dry, or the borani will turn watery.
A few toasted walnuts or a pinch of dried mint on top are both traditional.
Frozen spinach works: thaw and squeeze it dry first.
storage: Refrigerate in a covered container up to 3 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
